title: Perturbed-teacher tranche
subtitle: Train on the policy's own mistakes: the teacher is pushed up to 15 mm off on the way down and corrects from the step-180 view
why: Every training episode came from a teacher that is perfectly centred at step 180, so the policy never learned to use its close-up second look: lateral error 11.4 mm at step 179 and 11.2 mm at step 250 (tranche analysis 2026-09-18) against a grasp tolerance of about 8 mm. The perturbed teacher (notes/handoff-20261105.md step 1) shifts its first descent by an offset uniform in a 15 mm disk, recentres at 20 mm above the grasp point in 185-200 and descends onto the cube by 225; the survey-frame chunk keeps the clean label (DART).

experiments.title: Capture 4800 perturbed placements
experiments.question: Does the perturbed teacher fill a 4800-placement suite (both the clean and the perturbed teacher must pass each placement)?
experiments.success_means: A complete capture: suite seed 15, frame row stride 30, held-out poses shared with the ladder.
experiments.label: perturbed-capture

experiments.title: CNN on perturbed data, seed 202
experiments.question: Does the step-180 chunk now correct?
experiments.success_means: Pooled over the three seeds: step-250 lateral rms under 4 mm and below step 179, not-descended 0; then held-out successes vs the 4800 baseline (6/30) and the 2400 seeds (33/90).
experiments.label: perturbed-vision-s202

experiments.question: Seed repeat for the pooled judgement.

experiments.question: Seed repeat for the pooled judgement.

experiments.title: ACT fine-tune on perturbed data
experiments.question: Does ACT trained on perturbed 4800 + unperturbed 2400 beat the same recipe on unperturbed data?
experiments.success_means: Beats its own baseline (20/30, rms250 3.3 mm, not-descended 3): fewer not-descended, lower rms250, more successes. The absolute 4 mm target is already met by the baseline.
experiments.label: perturbed-act-ft

experiments.title: ACT PPO from the perturbed fine-tune
experiments.question: Does RL on top of the perturbed fine-tune beat ACT + PPO from the unperturbed one (24/30)?
experiments.success_means: More than 24/30 at execute 90 with zero safety frames.
experiments.label: perturbed-rl-act
